## Local Bakery's "Sunrise Bloom" Croissant Sparks City-Wide Craving

**Oakhaven, October 26, 2023 –** What started as a seasonal experiment at "The Daily Crumb" bakery has quickly become an Oakhaven phenomenon. The bakery’s new “Sunrise Bloom” croissant, featuring a delicate lavender honey glaze and a hint of orange zest, is selling out within hours each morning, prompting lines down Elm Street and a flurry of social media posts.

Owner and head baker, Elias Thorne, says the idea for the croissant came from a desire to capture the feeling of a crisp autumn morning. "I wanted something that felt bright and comforting," Thorne explained while overseeing the morning rush. “We started testing different flavour combinations a few weeks ago, and the lavender honey just… clicked. It complements the buttery pastry perfectly.”

The unexpected popularity has taken the small bakery, a staple in Oakhaven for nearly fifteen years, somewhat by surprise.  Customers began mentioning the croissant on local Facebook groups last week, praising its unique flavour profile and visually striking presentation – the croissant is artfully finished with a swirl of the lavender glaze, resembling a blooming flower. 

“I usually go for a plain croissant, but I saw a picture of this one online and had to try it,” said resident Sarah Miller, who was third in line this morning. “It’s worth the wait, honestly. It’s light, flaky, and the flavour is just incredible.”

The Daily Crumb is currently baking three batches of the Sunrise Bloom croissant each day, but Thorne admits they are still struggling to meet demand.  “We’re increasing production as much as possible, but we don’t want to compromise on quality,” he said. “Everything is still made by hand, using the same techniques we’ve always used.”

The bakery is advising customers to arrive early or pre-order through their website, though pre-order slots are currently booked solid for the next two weeks. Local coffee shops have also reported a surge in demand for lavender-infused beverages, suggesting the “Sunrise Bloom” croissant may be starting a new trend in Oakhaven’s culinary scene.

The Daily Crumb is located at 14 Elm Street and open from 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM, Tuesday through Sunday.
